_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: Experience spec contract
requirements.description: Validate `experience/` (index, pages, journeys, and components) against `.vrooli/schemas/scenario-experience-spec.schema.json` plus parser checks: unique IDs, resolvable references (routes, PRD OTs, DESIGN.md states, bindings, component examples), enforcement-tier rules, and open-world semantics, with a frozen finding-code vocabulary.

validation.notes: Parses the three golden fixture scenarios through the Go parser with contract-green verdicts. Last full scenario suite evidence: 20260705-222420-97ab2e55 experience phase PASS.
Covers cross-file parser checks and emitted contract finding codes for unresolved refs, PRD mismatch, tier violations, and orphan bindings.
Covers `experience-component` parser support, component index parity, example references, and the RCL Button pilot.

requirements.title: Scenario validation provider
requirements.description: Implement `ScenarioValidationService` for the canonical `experience` phase with findings, metrics, maturity ladders, and fix preview/apply, discovered by Test Genie through `.vrooli/test-genie.json` with presence-keyed applicability.

validation.notes: Proves the shared ScenarioValidationService response is sourced from the parser report and includes maturity assessment data.
Proves the EXPERIENCE_ALIGNMENT_GATE strict knob controls shared provider status while advisory mode remains non-gating.

requirements.title: Structure reconciliation
requirements.description: Drive Browser Automation Studio to capture a screenshot plus accessibility tree per declared page/state and per experience-component example/viewport, then check every machine-tier claim against the captured tree, persisting per-claim evidence; BAS unavailability yields skipped findings, never failures. Component reconciliation is advisory until the component contract is promoted to gating.

validation.notes: Pins the business-health Matrix calibration to exactly eight advisory reconciliation findings.
Checks machine-tier claims against the BAS accessibility snapshot model for an active page.
Persists per-claim reconciliation evidence for passed active-page verdicts.
Builds RCL preview harness capture targets for component examples and persists component claim evidence.
Proves component reconciliation failures are advisory warnings while the contract is still being calibrated.

requirements.title: Authoring studio
requirements.description: Form-based spec authoring with live validation and CLI parity, satisfying the round-trip property: a spec saved through the studio re-validates to zero contract findings.

validation.notes: Proves submit -> preview -> apply writes a page draft that re-parses with zero contract error findings.
Covers the binding suggestion helper used by the studio authoring flow.

requirements.title: Self-spec dogfood
requirements.description: Experience Manager ships its own `experience/` folder at L3+ depth and validates green, serving as the first real proof of the spec schema on its own surfaces.

validation.ref: ui/src/app/routes.test.tsx::AppRouter renders the fleet page at /
validation.notes: Routes the dogfood Fleet page through the UI shell using the spec-backed selector set; full self-validation evidence: experience-manager experience phase 20260705-222420-97ab2e55 PASS.
Dogfood BAS cases cover all five active Experience Manager pages; latest full scenario suite evidence: 20260705-212724-bbb0868e PASS and follow-up experience phase 20260705-222420-97ab2e55 PASS.
